issue.ticket_raw: I need vscode for development but it is blocked

steps.description: Identify application blocking mechanism by querying IFEO registry key
steps.command: reg query "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\{{entities.application}}.exe"

steps.description: Remove IFEO Debugger value to unblock application execution
steps.command: reg delete "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\{{entities.application}}.exe" /v Debugger /f
steps.fallback_command: reg delete "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\{{entities.application}}.exe" /f

steps.description: Verify IFEO block removal by querying registry key again
steps.command: reg query "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\{{entities.application}}.exe"
